comment: Pack running, labor and money. Read by src/content/trade.ts. Coins are copper (100 = 1 silver, 10000 = 1 gold). A trade pack is crafted at a zone's specialty workbench from local produce plus labor, carried on your back (slowly), and sold at a trading post in another place: farther and riskier routes pay more, and every sale lowers that post's demand for that pack until it recovers. Material packs (kind 'material') are how building materials travel: crafted where the materials are gathered, hauled to a building site, never sold. `contracts`: each trading post posts requests for specific packs; fill one before it expires for bonus seals and coin on top of the normal price.
